restoration_note: Teaching 30 describes the Living Spirit's threefold accommodation (wind/fire/water as garments) by which the Lord's operative power orders the natural mind, then strips off the accommodations, scatters what was claimed for purification, and bears the purified upward. Most editor-confirmed restorations (ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ, ⲍⲃⲥⲱ keyword, ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ direction-words, perfect prefixes) hold up firmly under the spiritual reading. Moderate restorations include ⲟⲩⲉⲓⲛⲉ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧⲉ 'a single likeness' for the unifying form across three garments, ⲁϥⲃⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ for the laying-off action, and ⲍⲏⲧⲟⲩ for the directional 'from them' in the ascent. The verb body in section 1809 ({2}), the verb in 1817 ({19}), and the long lacuna {28} resisted secure restoration despite formula support, so they are marked unrestorable. The 'lower place / Zone / upper place' axis at the close confirms the descent-and-return arc.
